issues.on_page: Warrants Retired (1,426,302); Change in Payables (9,880) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES)
issues.issue: Recording these as other_financing follows the statement's presentation, and the arithmetic is correct (computed marked). However, warrants retired is debt principal repayment, and change in payables is an accrual adjustment, not a financing flow. Worth a human look, given the size (1.43M against 227K of revenue).

issues.on_page: Collection Fees, Engineering, Fiscal Agent Fees, Insurance, Maintenance, Professional Fees, Title Search Fees, Traffic Safety Devices
issues.issue: The statement lists spending by object only. Under the rules these general-government lines should carry review: 'listed by object'; none does. 'Traffic Safety Devices' 680 (disbursements[11], detail[12]) may fit streets/highways better.
Interest on special assessments is recorded as special assessments, by analogy with interest on property taxes. That is defensible, but investment income is an alternative reading (detail[15] same).
